description: Move sys_update_xml records to a different update set. Supports filtering by sys_ids, time range, or source update set. Extremely useful when records end up in wrong update set (e.g., "Default" instead of custom set). Reports progress during move operation.

record_sys_ids.description: Array of sys_update_xml sys_ids to move (optional)

source_update_set.description: Filter by source update set name (e.g., "Default") (optional)

time_range.description: Time range to filter records (optional - format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

update_set_id.description: Target update set sys_id to move records to (required)

name: SN-Move-Records-To-Update-Set
